title: kate-text: re-export Rope
summary: kate-text re-exports ropey::Rope so that kate-core and kate-lsp can name the rope type without their own ropey dependency. The change is one pub use line. The transaction outbox and the didChange builder use it.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add pub use ropey::Rope; after the other pub use lines in lib.rs. Add the test rope_is_re_exported at the end of the test module in lib.rs, or create that module when none exists, asserting kate_text::Rope::from_str("a\nb").len_lines() is 2. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: rope_is_re_exported
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because kate_text::Rope is not a path. After the change the rope type is reachable through kate-text.
